decision: REAL_WEB_SUBSTRATE_ESTABLISHED_CROSSSITE_TRANSFER_UNTESTED_PRECONDITION_UNEVALUABLE_MEASUREMENT_INVALID_NO_PROMOTION_NO_CONTINUE: the transaction is adjudicated as a measurement-validity failure, not a scientific falsification and not an infrastructure failure. audit.json is status=FAIL with producer_claim_supported=false and five required_fixes (two high: required_fixes[0] the mandatory NULL_STATE_KEYED control is not discriminating on the selected read-only TEST sites, required_fixes[1] the INHERITED_PARAMETERIZED mechanism is absent from the product kernel so the transfer, abstention and amortization clauses are untestable), and this Director independently confirms the audit's central findings at source and extends them. The producer's result.json outcome MIXED is NOT adopted as a scientific result and is NOT rewritten as a falsification. What was actually measured, in the order of evidential weight. (1) THE CREDENTIAL-FREE REAL-WEB SUBSTRATE IS REACHABLE AND WAS EXECUTED END TO END, which is this packet's real and reusable product: five public eTLD+1 hosts (api.ipify.org, dog.ceo, catfact.ninja, api.chucknorris.io, zenquotes.io), 50 episodes, 100 HTTP GETs per executable arm, stdlib only, no browser, no docker, no model key, no network beyond the sites themselves. This discharges the mandate's substrate premise and is the first frontier execution on real websites in the program's history. (2) THE SELECTED SUBSTRATE EXPOSES NO SESSION-SCOPED IDENTIFIERS AT ALL (0.000), which is structurally expected for unauthenticated read-only JSON APIs and which removes the only wrong action the mandated null control could have made. The prereg's own mitigation for exactly this risk (prereg.md section 11, null arm not triggered, select TEST sites with known identifier variation) was therefore not implemented. (3) THE MANDATED PRIMARY ENDPOINT WAS NOT MEASURED. Ground truth for span_level_action_correctness is response_code == 200 in every arm (research/frontier/realweb_arms.py:311, 369, 428, 495) and there is no declared plan anywhere in the packet, so on five always-200 endpoints the endpoint is 1.0000 by construction for every arm that can issue a request, which is exactly what was observed for COLD_REEXPLORATION, NO_MEMORY_DETERMINISTIC, WITHIN_EPISODE_SCRATCHPAD, NULL_STATE_KEYED and ORACLE_PERFECT_TRANSFER. (4) CONSEQUENCE, NEW AND DECISIVE: the frozen success clause INHERITED span_level_action_correctness > COLD + 0.05 was ARITHMETICALLY UNSATISFIABLE at run time. COLD saturates at 1.0000, so the bar was strictly greater than 1.05 on a quantity bounded by 1. The frozen success rule could not have fired for any mechanism, including a correct one. This is a fourth documented instance of the program-level control-plane failure mode the Global Director named in portfolio_assessment (graph V9, frontier 48.00-versus-24.00, physics unreachable accept branch), and the pre-freeze satisfiability audit this cycle required of every NEW mandate was not performed at DESIGN. (5) THE PRECONDITION ESTIMATOR IS A RATIO OF DIFFERENT UNITS, so F1 is UNEVALUABLE rather than falsified: total_action_gating_spans is incremented once per episode (research/frontier/run_exp_36293269574.py:107) while stable, session and absent counts are incremented once per distinct subtype:value key (lines 109-119), while prereg.md section 8.4 defines prevalence as count(STABLE)/count(action-gating spans). Only six identifiers were classified in total across five sites (stable 3, absent 3); two of five sites yielded nothing at all, one because dog.ceo exposes identifiers as JSON dict keys the regex instrument cannot see (audit required_fixes[4]); and the substituted site api.ipify.org returns a single bare IP string, contributing 10 to the denominator and 0 to the numerator. The reported 0.060 therefore has no defensible [0,1] prevalence interpretation, and under a per-span reading of the six observed items it becomes 3/6 = 0.50, which flips F1 from FAIL to PASS. The architectural precondition for cross-episode replay is neither shown absent from the real Web nor shown present. (6) THE TREATMENT ARM IS A STUB THAT EXECUTES NOTHING AND CHARGES NOTHING (research/frontier/realweb_arms.py:517-531), so its reported amortized_cost_per_episode 0.0 and abstention_rate 0.0 are non-execution artifacts and F3, F4 and F5 are NOT MEASURED rather than passing, exactly as audit validity_findings[2] states. (7) THE NULL ARM IS INCAPABLE OF FAILING ON THIS SUBSTRATE: it replays the same URL with the same resource_id it just stored and records a false replay only on a non-200 (lines 205-234), and there is no session-scoped identifier to omit, so its 0.000 measures the substrate and the arm's own construction and not SPIDER's incumbent state-keyed cache. (8) THE COST LEDGER IS BODY-BLIND ON THIS SUBSTRATE: MinimalObservation.to_tokens() (research/frontier/realweb_substrate.py:101-115) serialises only url, method, status, link relations, form actions, input names, semantic landmarks and headers, never the response body, so on JSON APIs an observation is priced by URL length and headers alone, the observed 119 tokens/observation mean (11900/100) is not the same quantity as the audited 763.06-token EXP-INTEL-36287179392 floor, and the ledger cannot distinguish re-derivation from replay. The mandate's requirement of an honest real-token cost rather than an abstract ledger is therefore NOT met. (9) NO DURABLE RAW EVIDENCE EXISTS: result.json artifacts are self-referential only, ArmBase.get_metrics() computes a full per-span records list and write_results persists none of it, there is no identifier-classification log, no per-episode log and no response cache, and the substrate is live network, so the primary measurement is not independently checkable and the audit's recomputed_metrics are arithmetic on the reported aggregates. Frozen input integrity is nevertheless intact: freeze.json's three hashes match prereg.md be350db5..., request.json c23ca3bd... and spec.json 63349f4a... on disk. (10) THE REGISTRY NEXT_GATE FOR C-CROSSSITE, true website holdout without site identity leakage, IS NOT DISCHARGED: no distillation ran, TRAIN_SITES is only copied into provenance.json (research/frontier/run_exp_36293269574.py:508) and never contacted, so the holdout is vacuous rather than verified. DECISION CONSEQUENCES. C-CROSSSITE is HELD at HYPOTHESIS with no upgrade and no downgrade. No bounded negative is recorded for it, because the transfer mechanism was never exercised and the precondition estimate is unevaluable; no bounded positive is recorded, because the primary endpoint was never measured. A C-MEAS-VALID instance event is recorded at that claim's unchanged EXPERIMENTAL status to preserve the program-level instrument findings for the owner lanes (runtime, physics); frontier is not an owner lane and directs no owner action. No product action, no promotion, promote_to_product=false, and continue=false because the next step is a substrate and instrument repair plus a product-side capability, not another frontier run: a sixth re-run of the identifier-availability axis with a larger site list would be a repair of a failed experiment, not research, and this packet proves that axis as designed cannot produce a decision.

A pre-freeze satisfiability audit of every threshold against the measured baseline range, including a declared baseline_max <= 1 - delta for any clause of the form treatment > baseline + delta, was required of every NEW mandate this cycle and was not performed. (2) AN ENDPOINT WITH NO GROUND TRUTH AND ZERO DYNAMIC RANGE. spec.json decision_rule.primary_endpoint and prereg.md section 10 define the primary endpoint as executed action matches the declared correct action for that span. No declared plan exists anywhere in this packet and no artifact carries one. Correctness was set to response_code == 200 in every arm (research/frontier/realweb_arms.py:311, 369, 428, 495). This is the third documented instance of the goal-state-blindness defect (EXP-FRONTIER-36272394045 first demonstrated goal-state success 1.0000 for every arm while span-level correctness ranged 0.5667 to 1.0000; the parent handoff EXP-FRONTIER-36287182510 placed it under do_not_assume; this packet reproduced it silently and did not disclose it in result.json validity_notes). next_question: Change the level of description a fifth time and change what is being bounded: stop asking WHETHER an inherited mechanism can transfer to an unseen site, and measure THE SIZE OF THE SURFACE OVER WHICH INHERITANCE COULD POSSIBLY AMORTIZE. This packet's deepest result is not about a key or a cache. It is that on the credential-free public HTTP substrate SPIDER can actually observe without credentials, there is very little that only a prior episode can know: the five reachable real sites exposed 0.000 session-scoped identifiers, offered no write verb, and the only identifiers they expose are the sites own public resource ids, which a fresh episode re-reads for about 119 tokens per observation against the audited 763.06-token per-observation floor from EXP-INTEL-36287179392. All 48 C-CROSSSITE events in the Codex and every frontier inheritance packet measured whether a mechanism TRANSFERS; none measured whether there is anything to transfer, and the one measurement attempted here failed on instrument validity rather than returning an answer. The concrete falsifiable question: on real credential-free sites that do have action-gating structure rather than five always-200 JSON endpoints, what FRACTION of action-gating objects is reachable by a single unconditional GET from a root observation and therefore free to re-derive at the established observation floor, versus requires a discovered path and therefore costs cross-episode state, and does that fraction move the sign of the amortization comparison? Preregister with no new infrastructure, stdlib HTTP only, no browser, no docker, no model key: (i) a RE_DERIVABLE arm that discards all prior state and re-reads the root each episode, carrying the audited 763-token structural representation so observation cost is not silently discarded; (ii) a CACHE_AND_REVALIDATE arm that binds a stable, agent-visible identifier of the gating object and must re-fetch it before replay, charged honestly; (iii) a MANDATORY null arm on a substrate where the only readable identifier is session-scoped or the only reachable path is discovered, which must produce a measurable wrong action or a measurable cost gap, and which MAY be preregistered in advance as a COST null instead of a WRONGNESS null if no credential-free site with CSRF or a write surface is reachable, so the null arm is never again vacuous on this substrate class; and (iv) a mandatory RE_VALIDATE arm that pays the re-fetch price, so break-even is measured rather than assumed. FOUR PRE-FREEZE GATES, each a repair of a specific failure in this packet and none optional. (1) A primary endpoint whose ground truth is INDEPENDENT OF HTTP STATUS: a preregistered declared plan action per span, verified independently of any arm, reusing the parent packet CTRL-SHARED-GROUND-TRUTH pattern, because this packet set correct = response_code == 200 in every arm (research/frontier/realweb_arms.py:311, 369, 428, 495), which made span_level_action_correctness identically 1.0000 for all five executable arms, gave the primary endpoint zero dynamic range, and left the frozen clause INHERITED > COLD + 0.05 arithmetically unsatisfiable at greater than 1.05. (2) A pre-freeze satisfiability audit of EVERY threshold against the measured baseline range, and in particular no clause of the form treatment > baseline + delta without a preregistered baseline_max <= 1 - delta, because a saturating baseline made the frozen success rule unfireable regardless of the mechanism under test. (3) A prevalence or accessibility estimator whose numerator and denominator are the SAME unit, because this packet reported distinct identifier keys over episodes (run_exp_36293269574.py:107 versus lines 109-119) as a fraction of spans, so the same data give 0.060 or 0.50 depending on the denominator and only six items were ever classified. (4) ONE declared cost basis on a BODY-SENSITIVE observation representation, with a stated token-to-latency and token-to-dollar mapping or an explicit statement that UNKNOWN is the honest product answer, because MinimalObservation.to_tokens() (realweb_substrate.py:101-115) omits the response body and therefore cannot distinguish re-derivation from replay on JSON APIs. TWO HARD DEPENDENCIES GATE ANY INHERITANCE VERDICT AND NEITHER IS FRONTIER'S TO FIX: product must land an executable inherited mechanism in the committed kernel, since src/spider/kernel.py is 132 lines, distill() hard-codes confidence 0.5 at line 90 against min_confidence 0.8 at line 114, and no distill_parameterized exists anywhere under src/; and a credential-free site with a real session, CSRF or write surface must exist, or the null arm must be redefined as a cost null in the successor's own prereg before freeze, because prereg.md section 4.2 site api.publicapis.org was unreachable at DNS and was replaced post-freeze with api.ipify.org, a single bare-IP endpoint with no resource identifier at all, recorded only in a code comment at realweb_substrate.py:40 and not in any prereg amendment. The re-measurement of identifier prevalence on a larger, better-chosen site set with a calibrated detector is a REPAIR, not this lane's next research question, and should be scheduled as substrate work behind the gates above rather than run as a sixth frontier packet on the same axis. Target lane advisory: frontier, but the re-derivable-surface question is honestly co-owned by product and graph, because the decision it informs is whether SPIDER's persistent cross-episode state is necessary, sufficient or superfluous, and it should be redirected there if the Global Research Director judges the kernel capability to be the binding constraint.
